mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `objective_submission` (user_id, question_id, answer, correct, score) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questionId}, #{answer}, #{correct}, #{score})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT question_id FROM `objective_submission` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND correct = 1

SELECT s.id AS submissionId, s.user_id AS userId, s.question_id AS questionId, q.content AS questionContent, q.content AS questionTitle, u.username AS username, q.type AS type, s.answer AS answer, s.correct AS correct, q.answer AS correctAnswer, s.score AS score, q.score AS fullScore, s.created_at AS createdAt FROM `objective_submission` s LEFT JOIN `objective_question` q ON q.id = s.question_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = s.user_id
ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
